quote: Whenever a vehicle is parked or stopped upon the traveled portion of a highway or shoulder adjacent thereto, whether attended or unattended during the times mentioned in NRS 484D.100 [NRS-484D-100-1], and there is insufficient light to reveal any person or object within a distance of 1,000 feet upon such highway or roadway, such vehicle shall display lighted lamps meeting the requirements of subsection 1 [(1) appended below]. Every vehicle shall be equipped with one or more lamps which, when lighted, shall display a white or amber light visible from a distance of 500 feet to the front of the vehicle, and one or more lamps which, when lighted, shall display a red light visible from a distance of 500 feet to the rear of the vehicle. The location of such lamps shall be such that at least one such lamp is installed as near as practicable to the side of the vehicle which is closest to passing traffic.

activation.condition: Vehicle parked or stopped on traveled highway portion or adjacent shoulder during referenced NRS 484D.100 times, with insufficient revelation light.

obligation.description: Display lighted front white or amber and rear red lamps visible from 500 feet; traffic-side installation near as practicable.

timing.description: During the parked or stopped interval under referenced times and insufficient light.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: insufficient light to reveal any person or object within a distance of 1,000 feet
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original 1,000-foot station and source light condition require independent visual review.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: visible from a distance of 500 feet
judgment_calls_needed.note: Front/rear lamp pixels, color and both 500-foot stations require independent review.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: as near as practicable to the side of the vehicle which is closest to passing traffic
judgment_calls_needed.note: Source traffic side and installation geometry require independent review.

parameter_refs.range_or_domain: on or off requested lamp state
